markscheme.marking_summary: Exact original MS leaf excerpt: Award [3 max] Award [1 mark] for stating the concept clearly Award [2 max] for implications/development Concept: the processing of the script occurs on the web server rather than on the browser of the client; Implications: there is a consistent result regardless of the processing capacity of the client device; only the processed result is seen; and the processing is secure on the server; underlying data is secure on the server; the speed of processing will be consistent. offers more consistent experience for end user; and greater control for the site owner;
